The issuer exhibits solid profitability with an operating margin of 14% and net income of $2,401M, supported by a healthy liquidity profile indicated by a current ratio of 1.44 ($52,485M in current assets against $36,558M in current liabilities) and a deep base of retained earnings ($65,448M). However, the balance sheet is highly leveraged with total liabilities of $77,267M relative to shareholders' equity of $21,318M (a debt-to-equity oriented leverage ratio of approximately 3.6x), which constrains the rating to the lower end of the investment-grade spectrum. Based on this moderate financial risk profile balanced by robust earnings, the issuer warrants a solid investment-grade rating.

DECISION: BBB
